expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The reply quotes the captured error "pageerror: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12 (line 1 column 13)", which it saw after clicking "Load report" in headless Chromium.

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply says "the JSON string at `app.html:5` is missing its closing brace: const data = JSON.parse('{"total": 12');".
